subject.title: Feature Request: Add parseMode config for Telegram channels

question: Should Telegram gain a general formatting-mode setting beyond the existing `richMessages` toggle, and if so which modes and precedence should it support?
rationale: Choosing plain-only versus MarkdownV2 or raw HTML, account inheritance, and interaction with `richMessages` changes the public configuration, rendering, and escaping contract; repository evidence cannot determine that product choice.

options.title: Add HTML and plain modes
options.body: Keep standard HTML as the default, add a plain-text opt-out, and leave MarkdownV2 or raw HTML to narrower future decisions.

options.title: Add a full mode selector
options.body: Support plain, HTML, and MarkdownV2 with explicit escaping and precedence rules across every Telegram delivery path.

options.title: Fix formatter bugs only
options.body: Retain the existing HTML and `richMessages` model and address concrete rendering regressions without another configuration surface.

recommendation.title: Add HTML and plain modes
recommendation.body: Keep standard HTML as the default, add a plain-text opt-out, and leave MarkdownV2 or raw HTML to narrower future decisions.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal spans the original HTML behavior, current Telegram configuration, and recent channel documentation.
